column1: # excise licence policy (#1061). Three states, keyed on SPDX id.
# Enforced by scripts/check-license-compliance.sh over the shipped package
# closure. Anything NOT listed here is REVIEW: the build fails and asks Marc to
# classify it. Silence is not permission.
# Ship freely. Permissive, no copyleft, no field-of-use restriction. All of
# these still require the notice to travel with the redistribution, which is
# what the verbatim-text half of the compliance check enforces.

column3: permissive, no notice required in binaries
fonts; reserved-name clause does not bind us

column1: # Fail the build. No exception mechanism, deliberately: a copyleft or
# field-of-use dependency is a decision about what excise IS, not a build
# detail to be waived by whoever hits it. If one of these is ever genuinely
# needed, the conversation is about removing it from this list, in the open.

column3: weak copyleft; linking obligations excise cannot honour as a single-file publish
share-alike on a licence not designed for software
